movers.headline: **approves raising equity share capital of up to INR 1,000 crore through a Qualified Institutional Placement, in one or more tranches**, at a board meeting that ran from **5:00 p.m. to 10:05 p.m.** and in continuation of its intimation of **05-Aug**. This is **the largest genuinely fresh equity call on today's tape** and the only one from a scheduled commercial bank. **State the stage plainly:** it is a board approval **subject to the approval of shareholders and to such other regulatory approvals as may be applicable** — no issue size per tranche, no price, no floor and no timetable are stated, and a QIP is priced only when it opens. At ~5.9% of a Rs 17,084.85 cr market capitalisation the dilution, if taken in full, is real but moderate. *(Filed at 22:14, more than two hours after the scheduled feed cycle had closed its read of the day; it reached this digest only because an extra cycle was run before writing.)*
movers.quantum: Rs 1,000.00 cr QIP — board approved, pending shareholders; ~5.9% of mcap

movers.headline: **secures a Rs 524.17 crore contract from NHPC Limited at the Salal Power Station in Jammu & Kashmir** — **civil and hydro-mechanical works, with associated ancillary and enabling works, to make the undersluices of the concrete dam fully functional and operational** — with a stated duration of **27 months**. The rehabilitation is intended to improve sediment management and the dam's long-term safety and reliability. HCC built the 690 MW Salal Hydroelectric Project itself, commissioned in 1987, and states that Uri-II (240 MW), Kishanganga (333 MW), Nimoo Bazgo (45 MW) and Chutak (44 MW) together represent about **38% of J&K's installed hydropower capacity**. At ~9.9% of a Rs 5,286.09 cr market cap this is **the largest single rupee-denominated order on the tape today**. *(Recovered: the baseline stored no amount for this row and filed it under Business updates — the figure lives only in the press release's subject line and body, which the extractor could not anchor.)*
movers.quantum: Rs 524.17 cr from NHPC, 27 months; ~9.9% of mcap

movers.headline: **receives orders for setting up Battery Energy Storage System projects aggregating 200 MW / 400 MWh in Tamil Nadu**, through subsidiary **Bondada Renewable Energy Private Limited**, and **an order for the supply of 100 BSNL towers for locations in Udaipur and Ahmedabad** through **Bondada Green Engineering Private Limited**. The Regulation 30 annexure puts the **broad consideration at Rs 5,13,93,93,532 including taxes**, scheduled for completion or delivery **during FY 2026-27**. **Two disclosures in that same annexure belong in the same sentence as the number, because they change what it means:** the awarding entity is named only as **"Leading telecom and energy EPC companies"**, and to the questions *whether the promoter / promoter group / group companies have any interest in the entity awarding the order* and *whether the order would fall within related party transactions* the company answers **"Yes"** to both. At ~15.9% of a Rs 3,242.35 cr market cap it is the second-largest order on the tape and the one that most needs reading twice. The company separately states a **consolidated group order book of ~Rs 10,023 crore** — a cumulative figure, not this award. *(Recovered: the baseline held the row out of movers entirely, its own `event_confirm` recording `mismatch:capex_expansion` between the subject tag and the filing.)*
movers.quantum: Rs 513.94 cr incl taxes — a RELATED-PARTY award; ~15.9% of mcap

movers.headline: reports that its **material subsidiary Saatvik Solar Industries Private Limited has received and accepted an order aggregating INR 400.16 crore for the supply of solar photovoltaic modules**, to be **executed by March 2027**. The Regulation 30 annexure is otherwise complete — domestic entity, commercial in nature, no promoter or promoter-group interest, not a related-party transaction — with **one deliberate omission: the counterparty is described only as "one renowned Independent Power Producer / EPC Player" and is not named**. At ~7.5% of a Rs 5,324.43 cr market cap it is a full quarter's worth of module offtake committed in a single order, and it sits in movers rather than a theme line because a single named buyer, a single stated value and a single execution deadline are all present — only the buyer's identity is withheld.
movers.quantum: INR 400.16 cr solar modules, by March 2027; ~7.5% of mcap

movers.headline: tells the exchanges that **members have approved, by special resolution through a postal ballot declared today, the sale of the Friction Business Undertaking as a going concern on a slump-sale basis** under Section 180(1)(a) and Regulation 37A. **The buyer is Rane (Madras) Limited** — not a promoter or promoter-group entity — and the **consideration is INR 370 crore in cash, subject to transaction adjustments specified in the Business Transfer Agreement, payable on the closing date**. The scale is the point: the undertaking being sold **turned over INR 315.04 crore in FY2025-26, or 84% of the whole company's turnover**, against a **net worth of INR 69.52 crore, 7.50% of the company's**. Completion is **expected on or before 30-Sep-2026**, subject to closing conditions. At ~59.9% of a Rs 617.64 cr market cap this is **the largest proportional transaction on the tape**. **One qualification, because the number is not new:** the BTA was executed on **30-Jun-2026** and today's filing expressly carries forward that intimation's Annexure A — what changed today is that the condition precedent it was subject to, shareholder approval, has been obtained.
movers.quantum: Rs 370.00 cr cash slump sale to Rane (Madras); ~59.9% of mcap

movers.headline: reports in its **monthly business update** that it has **secured new business in Transportation and Warehousing worth nearly INR 342 crore**. **Read the components, because only one of the three carries a figure:** the bulk is a **contract valued at approximately Rs 334 crore from HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited (HRRL) for pan-India polymer granule distribution out of Pachpadra, Rajasthan**; alongside it are a **transportation contract from Mangalore Refinery & Petrochemicals (MRPL)** covering services from Mangalore, and a **warehousing contract from ONGC Petro additions Limited (OPAL) across multiple locations in Gujarat**, **neither of which is valued in the filing**. At ~39.0% of a Rs 876.43 cr market cap (the HRRL leg alone is ~38.1%) this is the largest proportional order-book addition of the day. It is a **monthly aggregate rather than a single award**, and the company does not state the contract tenors.
movers.quantum: ~Rs 342 cr of new business, of which Rs 334 cr from HRRL; ~39.0% of mcap

movers.headline: **receives a contract from the Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority (GNIDA) for the procurement and engagement of Electric Mechanical Road Sweeping Machines together with comprehensive operation and maintenance, for roads under the jurisdiction of Greater Noida (East Zone)**. The term is **five years, extendable by a further two**, and the company states the **project revenue over the five years would be approximately Rs 243.22 crore** — so read it as **~Rs 49 crore a year of contracted revenue, not a lump sum**. GNIDA is unconnected to the promoter group and the contract is expressly **not a related-party transaction**. At ~20.5% of a Rs 1,184.53 cr market cap, a five-year municipal annuity of this size is material to a company whose whole business is municipal solid-waste contracts. *(Recovered: the baseline stored no amount — the figure sits in row 7 of the Regulation 30 annexure, phrased as project revenue rather than as an order value.)*
movers.quantum: Rs 243.22 cr of project revenue over 5 years from GNIDA; ~20.5% of mcap

movers.headline: **bags two civil-construction orders totalling Rs 101.97 crore including GST**: **Rs 94.11 crore from Carrier Airconditioning and Refrigeration Limited** (the US company's Indian arm, contracting out of Haryana) for **execution of new project site establishment factory civil work at 12955 Central Expressway, Sri City, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh**, to be completed **before March 2027**; and **Rs 7.86 crore from Tractors and Farm Equipment Limited (TAFE), Chennai** for **civil and pre-engineered-building work at Maraimalai Nagar, Chengalpattu**, to be completed **before December 2026**. The same letter states **confirmed orders of Rs 1,101.59 crore excluding GST for execution during FY 2026-27, of which Rs 204.81 crore was billed in Q1**, and reaffirms **guidance of approximately 70% revenue growth** over FY2025-26's ~Rs 823 crore. ~12.5% of a Rs 818.72 cr market cap. *(⚠ Corrected, and this was the baseline's lead item. It published **Rs 22,155 crore at 2,706.1% of market cap**. That figure is the company's **BIDDING PIPELINE** — the letter says it *"has submitted bids for projects aggregating to approximately ₹22,155 crores"* and immediately applies a "conservative conversion assumption of 10%". Bids submitted are not orders received, and the two orders the filing actually announces are the ones above.)*
movers.quantum: Rs 101.97 cr incl GST across two orders; ~12.5% of mcap

business_updates: **Results season, and it is most of the day** — **614 of the 1,010 material rows are results filings, earnings-call transcripts or investor presentations**, from 295 companies. Per CLAUDE.md §2 a results press release can never supply an event amount, so the large rupee figures inside them are **revenue and profit, not deals**: **Manappuram Finance (consolidated PAT Rs 585 cr, up 341.40% YoY; AUM Rs 69,635 cr, up 57.20%; gold-loan AUM Rs 57,006 cr, up 97.9%; income from operations Rs 3,033 cr)**, **Gokaldas Exports (Rs 1,180 cr total income, up 21%)**, **MRF (Rs 8,610.56 cr)**, **Caliber Mining and Logistics (Rs 657.05 cr revenue, coal extraction 1.54 MMT, an order book of Rs 9,124.81 cr)**, **Asian Granito (Rs 530.95 cr, up 28.5%)**, **String Metaverse (Rs 392.42 cr)**, **Tembo Global (Rs 302 cr)**, **Vikran Engineering (Rs 204 cr)** and **Surya Roshni (Rs 2,046 cr, up 28%)** among them. All excluded by design.

**Kalpataru Projects International** — reports **order inflows of about Rs 6,408 crore so far this financial year and a consolidated order book of Rs 66,607 crore**, both cumulative figures in a results release rather than an announced award, and neither becomes an event amount. **Insecticides (India)**, **Repco Home Finance (loan book Rs 15,990 cr)**, **Dam Capital**, **Innova Captab**, **RHI Magnesita**, **Speciality Restaurants**, **Fermenta Biotech**, **Matrimony.com**, **Wanbury**, **Man Industries**, **Hind Rectifiers**, **Piccadily Agro**, **Royal Orchid Hotels**, **BSL**, **Take Solutions**, **Krishival Foods**, **Pyramid Technoplast**, **Nephrocare**, **Allcargo Terminals**, **TCPL Packaging** and **Laxmi Dental** filed quarterly numbers with no transaction attached.

**Embassy Developments** — reports **pre-sales growth of approximately 338% year on year** to open FY27, with no absolute figure in the subject line. **Tembo Global** separately announced that **four solar power generation sites of group companies became operational during August 2026** — three in Dhule district and one in Jalgaon, Maharashtra — **with no capacity or cost stated**. **L&T Technology Services** launched **AgenticIQ™**, an end-to-end agentic AI platform for engineering, manufacturing and customer experience; **Tata Consultancy Services** and Google Cloud opened a **Gemini Experience Center in Mexico**; **Coforge** launched a **Private Equity business unit**; **V-Mart Retail** opened its **600th store**; **ITI**, **Dachepalli Publishers** (a notebook brand) and **Omaxe** (a project launch) filed announcements with no commercial terms.
capex_core: **SJVN** — **achieves Commercial Operation Date on the 75 MW Jamui Solar Power Project in Bihar**, executed through wholly-owned subsidiary **SJVN Green Energy Limited** on **approximately 300 acres of outright-purchased land near Village Hadhadiya, Kakanchaur**, at an **estimated project cost of Rs 1,342 crore**. The company expects **~90 million units in the first year and ~3,522 million units cumulatively over 25 years**, at a **tariff fixed at Rs 2.96 per unit**, with the power supplied to the State of Bihar. At ~5.0% of a Rs 26,683.31 cr market cap. It is the largest completed capital asset on the tape and it belongs here rather than in movers because **the money was spent in prior years — a COD is the end of a capex, not the announcement of one**.

**Vidya Wires** — approves a **further investment of Rs 125,00,00,000 in ALCU Industries Private Limited, its wholly-owned subsidiary, by subscribing to 1,25,00,000 1% non-convertible redeemable preference shares of Rs 100 each**. ALCU manufactures aluminium and copper wires, tubes, rods, foils and related components, and turned over **Rs 12.44 crore in FY2025-26**. Two things keep it out of movers: it is an **own-subsidiary infusion, expressly a related-party transaction at arm's length**, and the instrument is **redeemable preference shares carrying a 1% coupon** — closer to intra-group funding than to equity. The company separately reports that **Rs 109.83 crore of the Rs 140.00 crore IPO allocation for ALCU's new project has been utilised**, with Rs 30.17 crore unspent and **no deviation** from the objects.

**Escorts Kubota** — the **groundbreaking ceremony for its new greenfield manufacturing facility at the YEIDA Industrial Area, Uttar Pradesh, has been brought forward to 19-Aug** from 20-Aug, with the company stating that **no unpublished price-sensitive information will be shared at the event**; **the intimation carries no project cost, capacity or timeline**, so there is nothing to size. **Focus Lighting and Fixtures**, **JNK India**, **Sacheerome**, **Surya Roshni**, **PI Industries** (a proposed Section 8 company), **Pee Cee Cosma Sope** and **Choksi Asia** filed capex, investment and incorporation disclosures **with no material rupee commitment stated**. **Steel Authority of India** filed a **rumour-verification letter** under Regulation 30(11).
distress_risk: **Nitin Castings** — the **reverse book-building process for its voluntary delisting from BSE closed today**, having opened 05-Aug. Against a **floor price of Rs 273.36**, the **discovered price is Rs 300.00 per equity share**, on **9 successful bids totalling 7,53,984 equity shares** in a range from Rs 273.36 to Rs 300.00, against a **delisting offer size of 14,70,894 shares**; **1,54,994 shares were bid above the discovered price**. At Rs 300 the full offer size would cost the acquirers about **Rs 44.13 crore** against a Rs 221.85 cr market capitalisation — **that multiplication is ours, and the filing does not state whether the acquirers have accepted the discovered price**, which is the step that matters and has not happened yet.

**Punj Lloyd**, **Baron Infotech**, **BIL Vyapar**, **Mcnally Bharat Engineering** and **Vidya Wires** — corporate insolvency resolution process intimations and committee-of-creditors notices, **none carrying a quantified impact**. **MMTC** — a **statement on the impact of audit qualification** for the quarter, standalone and consolidated. **Simbhaoli Sugars** submitted a **Supreme Court order dated 07-Aug** on an appeal filed by a promoter and by farmers, without stating the outcome's financial effect.

**Glenmark Pharmaceuticals**, **HCL Infosystems**, **Delta Corp**, **Teamlease Services** (an appeal by TeamLease Skills University in the Gujarat High Court), **Manorama Industries** (a clarification on delay in disclosure under Regulation 30), **Speciality Restaurants**, **Manaksia Steels** and **Adani Green Energy** (a further update on the US matter) — litigation and material-issue disclosures, **each pending with no amount quantified**.
equity_allotments: **Optiemus Infracom** — allots **1,67,250 equity shares of Rs 10 on conversion of an equal number of fully convertible warrants allotted on 08-Feb-2025 at an issue price of Rs 672.25, aggregating Rs 11,24,33,812.50**, to three non-promoter allottees — **Jalan Chemical Industries Private Limited (1,20,000), Veetragi Infratech Private Limited (40,000) and Nikhil Kedarnath Chandak (7,250)**. This is a **past conversion** in the CLAUDE.md §4 sense: the capital was committed eighteen months ago and today only completes it. Paid-up capital rises to Rs 90,16,64,500; ~0.23% of a Rs 4,958.59 cr market cap.

**Transteel Seating Technologies** — allots **13,31,500 equity shares of Rs 10 at Rs 80 (a Rs 70 premium) on conversion of warrants issued 12-Feb-2025**, to the non-promoter and public category, **on receipt of the balance Rs 7,98,90,000 at Rs 60 per warrant, being 75% of the issue price** — another past conversion, and the balance received is the only cash that moved today. **Ganesh Infraworld** (10,49,600 shares), **Fischer Medical Ventures** and **Chatha Foods** (a BSE listing approval for 1,03,000 shares) filed warrant conversions and listing approvals with no amount in the intimation.

**Garnet International — this is the opposite of an allotment, and the store recorded it as one.** The company disclosed the **expiry of the conversion window and proposed forfeiture of 27,00,000 convertible warrants** issued on a preferential basis on 10-Feb-2025 at Rs 131 each. **The subscribers across both promoter and non-promoter categories failed to pay the remaining 75% (Rs 98.25 per warrant) within the 18-month tenure under ICDR Regulation 169(3), so all 27,00,000 warrants stand lapsed and unexercised, and there is no change in the paid-up share capital.** The **Rs 8,84,25,000 of upfront money is to be transferred to the Capital Reserve Account** at a board meeting on 14-Aug, and the defaulting allottees are **ineligible for any preferential issue of the company for one year** under Regulation 159(2). *(Corrected: the row was stored as `equity_allotment` / `warrant_conversion_past` at Rs 35.37 crore — which is 27,00,000 × Rs 131, the value of an issue that has just failed. Capital that was never raised is not capital raised.)*
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **String Metaverse** (formerly Bio Green Papers) — the board **approved raising funds in one or more tranches for an aggregate amount up to and not exceeding Rs 1,000 crore, through equity shares and/or other eligible securities including convertible securities, warrants, ADRs, GDRs and/or FCCBs**, by any permissible mode including public issue, preferential issue, private placement and QIP. **At ~125.9% of a Rs 794.16 cr market capitalisation this is the largest proportional capital call on the tape** — the company is authorising itself to issue more than its own market value. It is a theme line and not a mover for one reason: it is an **enabling ceiling with no mode, no size per tranche, no price and no timetable**, expressly **subject to shareholder approval**, and the AGM that would grant it is **25-Sep-2026**. The same board meeting reported **Q1 FY27 revenue of Rs 392.42 crore, up 97.13% year on year, and PAT of Rs 36.92 crore, up 101.80%**.

**KJMC Corporate Advisors** — the board **approved the proposal for raising funds up to Rs 20 crore**, at **~97.6% of a Rs 20.48 cr market capitalisation** — proportionally the second-largest call of the day and, in absolute terms, one of the smallest sums on the tape. The same board outcome carries only routine business otherwise: Q1 results, a company secretary appointment and two independent-director re-appointments. **P H Capital** (being renamed **AHB Capital**, the Registrar of Companies having made the name available on 10-Aug following a **change in control**) is weaker still and should not be read as a raise: its board **"discussed and authorized the Whole-time Directors to explore various avenues to raise funds"** — **including borrowings from banks or financial institutions and the issue of debentures or debt securities** as well as a preferential issue — **up to an aggregate not exceeding Rs 200 crore**, with details to be disclosed *"as and when the same is finalized"*. An authority to explore, part of it debt, at ~67.3% of a Rs 29.7 cr market cap.

**North Eastern Carrying Corporation** — the board approved **two** things and only one is equity: **1,00,00,000 convertible warrants to the promoters on a preferential basis at Rs 18.51 each, aggregating Rs 18.51 crore** (~11.9% of a Rs 155.50 cr market cap), each warrant convertible into one equity share, **either for cash or against outstanding unsecured loans owed to the promoters**; and separately **fund-raising by way of secured and/or unsecured loans of up to Rs 50 crore, including loans carrying an option to convert into convertible securities**. Both are **subject to a shareholders' special resolution**. *(Corrected: the store filed the warrant row as `warrant_conversion_past`. These are new warrants proposed to promoters, not the completion of an old issue — CLAUDE.md §4's `new_warrant`.)* **Nexome Capital Markets** — a **Rs 22.04 crore (Rs 2,203.875 lakh) preferential allotment**, ~16.9% of a Rs 130.39 cr market cap, filed four separate times under four different subjects on the same day.

**Held out as debt or as an enabling limit, per CLAUDE.md §3 — and the two largest "raises" on the tape are both.** **Starteck Finance's Rs 1,500 crore** is described by the company itself as **"a yearly practice ... an enabling resolution, hence no specific issue details can be mentioned"**, and it splits **Rs 1,000 crore of non-convertible debt by private placement** from **Rs 500 crore of equity or equity-convertible securities**; at 591% of a Rs 253.75 cr market cap it would have ranked second on the day. **Manappuram Finance** approved **raising funds including listed non-convertible debentures, bonds and commercial papers as part of a proposed enhancement of its borrowing limits to Rs 1,00,000 crore** — a borrowing ceiling, roughly 2.9 times its own market value, and the clearest possible case of a limit that is not an act. Neither figure reached the store as an amount and neither should. **TD Power Systems** filed only a board-meeting intimation for a proposal to raise funds; **Concord Enviro Systems**, **Tacent Projects** and **Deccan Gold Mines** (an EGM notice, following the raise published on 08-Aug) are at earlier stages still.

**Held out — not fresh, not equity, or not this company's.** **Viyash Scientific** (formerly SeQuent Scientific) approved **subscription of up to Rs 400,02,15,648 to the rights issue of Alivira Animal Health Limited, its own wholly-owned subsidiary** — and the filing states that the **subscription amount shall be adjusted against the intercompany loan already extended**, that the purpose is **to strengthen AAHL's capital structure and reduce interest burden**, and that **being a wholly-owned subsidiary there is no change in shareholding**. It is a debt-to-equity conversion inside the group with no cash raised; the store nonetheless typed it `fund_raise` with `new_share_allotment` at Rs 400 crore. **Gokaldas Exports**, **Delhivery**, **SIS** and **Landmark Cars** filed **ESOP grants and allotments**; **Vidya Wires** filed a **Regulation 32 statement of NO deviation** on its December-2025 IPO proceeds (CLAUDE.md §1 drops these by type).
m_and_a: **Larsen & Toubro** — executes a **Business Transfer Agreement to transfer its Data Centre and Cloud Services Business, on a going-concern basis through a slump sale, to Vyoma.AI Limited, its wholly-owned subsidiary, for an aggregate consideration of Rs 1,400 crore subject to closing adjustments**; and, under a simultaneous **Share Purchase Agreement, divests 100% of L&T Network Services Private Limited to Vyoma for Rs 30 crore**. **Both considerations are to be discharged by the issue of fully paid equity shares of Vyoma**, not in cash, and closing is subject to the conditions agreed in the BTA and SPA. **Rs 1,430 crore is the largest stated consideration on today's tape** and it is a theme line for two independent reasons: it is **0.25% of a Rs 5,61,297.50 cr market capitalisation**, far below CLAUDE.md §5's bar, and it is an **intra-group reorganisation in which nothing leaves the consolidated entity** — L&T pays itself in its own subsidiary's paper, and LTNSPL simply moves from direct to indirect wholly-owned. *(Recovered: the baseline held the row out with no amount, its `event_confirm` recording a mismatch.)*

**Gokak Textiles** — the board approved, **subject to statutory and regulatory approvals, the permanent closure and subsequent sale of the company's knitwear unit at Bagalkot Road, Village Marihal, District Belagavi, Karnataka, on an as-is-where-is basis**. The unit sits on **15.65 acres of freehold land**, was set up in **1995** for the export market, and has already been hollowed out — the **specialised dyeing and knitting machinery was moved to the Gokak Falls mills division in 2015-16** and only cutting and stitching remained. **An agreement to sell the land, building and machinery to M/s V. G. Parekh & Co., Vijayapura was signed in September 2025** and intimated to BSE then; the Rs 19.50 crore the store carries (~50.4% of a Rs 38.67 cr market cap) belongs to that agreement, not to a new deal. **Closure is subject to labour-authority permission.** The store's own `event_confirm` reads `mismatch:closure` — and closure is the more accurate word.

**GEM Enviro Management** — executes a **Share Subscription Agreement with Solluz Energy Private Limited to acquire 21,10,680 equity shares representing 26% of its share capital**, in continuation of its 30-Jun intimation; **the agreement as filed states no consideration**, so no rupee figure is published here. **Computer Age Management Services** — an acquisition of **Rs 17.73 crore**, immaterial at ~0.09% of a Rs 19,577.14 cr market cap. **AvenuesAI** (formerly Infibeam Avenues) — the **amalgamation of its wholly-owned subsidiary Nueromind Technologies Private Limited into itself**, with Rs 66.00 crore and Rs 70.00 crore figures in the papers and ~1.1% of market cap either way; the store flags the row as a content mismatch and it is carried, not surfaced. **Kody Technolab** terminated a joint venture agreement, **Shrydus Industries** terminated a share purchase agreement, and **Gayatri Highways** filed amendments to one — three unwindings in a single day, none quantified.

**Godrej Properties**, **Puravankara**, **The Byke Hospitality**, **Emrock Corporation**, **Global Education** (which took OwnPrep Private Limited to wholly-owned by acquiring the remaining 49%), **Pudumjee Paper Products**, **Zodiac Clothing**, **Vaxfab Enterprises** and **Gujarat Energy** (fractional-entitlement compensation certified by its audit committee) — acquisition, scheme and restructuring disclosures, **none carrying a stated consideration or swap ratio in the intimation**.
order_wins: **Diamond Power Infrastructure** — receives **two purchase orders aggregating Rs 195.48 crore on basic value excluding GST, or Rs 230.67 crore including it, from Rajesh Power Services Limited, Ahmedabad**, an EPC contractor executing turnkey underground cabling, for the **supply of 11 kV Medium Voltage underground power cables** for **Paschim Gujarat Vij Company Limited (PGVCL)** projects under the **State Disaster Mitigation Fund scheme and the System Improvement (Urban Underground) programme**, with a focus on coastal areas, **to be executed over the next 12 months**. Both figures are stated by the company and both are published here, per the 08-Aug ruling that a filing giving two numbers should have both carried: ~1.03% of a Rs 18,997.31 cr market cap on the basic value, ~1.21% including tax. It clears CLAUDE.md §5 on either reading and no more than clears it — this is a large order for a company that is now large. *(Recovered: the baseline stored only the tax-inclusive figure.)*
**Sathlokhar Synergys' Rs 22,155 crore was the bid pipeline, not an order** — see the movers above for the two orders the filing actually announces and the full correction.

**BEML** — **secures an order worth Rs 184.25 crore from Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) for the manufacture and supply of Light Combat Helicopter (LCH) fuselage aerostructures**, disclosed in a two-paragraph Regulation 30 letter that states it is **in the normal course of business** and gives no execution period. It is the day's only defence-supply-chain award and a genuine domestic-airframe mandate; it is a theme line purely on §5 arithmetic — **Rs 184.25 cr against a Rs 15,694.98 cr market cap is 1.17%**, barely over the bar.

**Greenleaf Envirotech** — receives a **work order from M/s Meershiv Projects Private Limited aggregating Rs 30.05 crore inclusive of GST** for the **turnkey design, engineering, civil works, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of the complete electro-mechanical and instrumentation system for a 10 MLD waste-water treatment plant**, over **12 months**, with a **12-month defect liability period** on the executed pipe network. At **~44.9% of a Rs 67.00 cr market cap** it is proportionally the largest award of the day; it stays a theme line because Rs 30 crore is a small absolute sum and the counterparty is a private contractor rather than the end client.

**Innovision** — the press release the company filed today puts a number on the NHAI mandate that **ran unquantified in `highlights_2026-08-10_polished.md`**: the Letter of Award for the **Aashpur Fee Plaza at Design Km 231.100 on the Aligarh–Kanpur section of NH-91, Uttar Pradesh**, granted **10-Aug** after a competitive e-tender, runs **one year** with a **broad commercial consideration of Rs 83,29,29,635**, and the scope extends beyond toll collection to the upkeep of adjacent toilet blocks. **The company's own caveat is the reason this is not a mover, and it is unusually candid:** the figure *"reflects the gross value of the engagement under the toll collection framework, where collections are remitted to NHAI and the Company retains an agreed spread"* and *"should not be interpreted as an expected direct or proportionate addition to net revenue"*. So the ~12.4% of a Rs 672.01 cr market cap measures money passing through, not money earned. **Hazoor Multi Projects** filed the same class of item — an **NHAI Letter of Award dated 10-Aug for user-fee collection at the Ramnagar fee plaza at Km 1280.370 on the Baran–Shivpuri section of New NH-27 in Madhya Pradesh, at Rs 24.33 crore** (~4.0% of a Rs 611.78 cr market cap) — and the same gross-collection caveat applies to it.

**Advait Energy Transitions** — a **turnkey contract from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation Limited (GETCO) for the design, manufacture and supply of an Emergency Restoration System for 400 kV lines, suitable also for 220/132/66 kV class transmission lines**, against tender CE(P&C)/I/E-3059, received 10-Aug, at **Rs 24,88,10,504.80** (~1.04% of a Rs 2,393.13 cr market cap — the narrowest §5 pass on the tape). **Expo Engineering and Projects** disclosed **two separate work orders in one day**, both inclusive of taxes: **Rs 18.51 crore from Indian Oil Corporation (Pipelines Division, Western Region, Rajkot)** and **Rs 4.22 crore from Larsen & Toubro, Chennai** — Rs 22.73 crore together, ~12.5% of a Rs 182.37 cr market cap. **Dev Information Technology** — an order of **Rs 5.33 crore from the Settlement Commissioner and Director of Land Records, Gujarat**.

**Quantified nowhere, so not surfaced under CLAUDE.md §3.** **H.G. Infra Engineering** — a Letter of Award from the **Department of Skill, Employment & Entrepreneurship, Government of Rajasthan**, in continuation of its 13-Jul intimation, with no value stated. **South West Pinnacle Exploration** — an update on a Letter of Award from **CMPDI**. **Rachana Infrastructure**, **Ahasolar Technologies**, **Anlon Technology Solutions** (a July business update) and **Urban Enviro Waste Management** (Rs 1.64 cr, ~1.3% of mcap, below any threshold worth a sentence) round out the order tape.

**Already published — cross-day duplicates, not new events.** **Consolidated Construction Consortium's Rs 220 crore** of Buildings & Factories and Special Projects orders — BOQ-based item-rate contracts for 8.00 lakh square feet, executable before FY2028-29 — **ran as a theme line in `highlights_2026-08-10_polished.md`**; today's filing opens *"Further to our letter dated 10.8.2026"* and encloses the press release. It is the self-referential opening clause named as the reliable tell on 09-Aug, printed verbatim. **Vikran Engineering's Rs 3,517.98 crore 969 MW AC solar EPC contract** appears in today's results press release under *Recent Operational Highlights* — it is an award **from its own wholly-owned subsidiary NOPL Solar Projects**, and the release also restates a **Rs 120.7 crore POWERGRID 400 kV GIS substation order** and a **total order book of Rs 6,496.2 crore as at 11-Aug**. None of the three is today's news.
other_notable: **RSWM — already published, and the number has not changed.** The company **executed the Joint Venture Agreement with Barcelona-based Noize Design Studio (NDS9)** to build **LNJ NDS9 Global Private Limited**, an Industry 5.0 green garment manufacturing platform for **premium denim and activewear for international apparel brands**, held **74:26** by RSWM and NDS9. **The estimated project cost of approximately Rs 186.30 crore, the 30% equity / 70% term-loan funding mix and the JV company's name were all disclosed on 05-Aug and published as a mover in `highlights_2026-08-05_polished.md`**; today advances the stage from board approval to executed agreement. What is genuinely new is small and worth stating precisely: the **JV company's initial paid-up capital is Rs 1.00 crore** (10,00,000 shares of Rs 10), of which **RSWM subscribes 7,40,000 shares for Rs 74.00 lakh** — so the Rs 186.30 crore is a **project cost to be funded over time**, not a cheque written today. ~19.3% of a Rs 967.04 cr market cap on the project cost.

**Advanced Enzyme Technologies' Rs 69.70 crore buyback** — the board resolution ran as a **mover in `highlights_2026-08-08_polished.md`**; today's filing is the same buyback. Buybacks are structurally prone to this because the statutory public announcement always trails the board, exactly as recorded on 08-Aug for SIS.

**Credit-rating actions are theme-only and never movers (CLAUDE.md §3).** **Premier Polyfilm** — the only stated **revision** on the tape, on Rs 54 crore of facilities (~7.3% of mcap), and its second appearance in two days. **Automotive Stampings and Assemblies** — a rating disclosure carrying **Rs 169 crore** of facilities, which is the **size of the rated debt, not an event amount**, at 21.4% of its market cap. **Avenue Supermarts** — **Rs 300 crore** of rated facilities at 0.11% of market cap. Eleven further rating rows state **no notch change in the intimation**, so under §3 they are not surfaced as actions at all.

**Xtranet Technologies** — an **investment of Rs 15,24,99,974 in the equity shares of Xtratrust Digisign Private Limited**, in which it **already holds 98%**; a subsidiary recapitalisation (the target turned over Rs 25.39 crore in FY26), ~2.0% of a Rs 747.79 cr market cap, and not an acquisition. **JSW Dulux** — approves the **sub-division of each Rs 10 equity share into ten Rs 1 shares**; **S.P. Apparels** — a split from Rs 10 to Rs 2. Splits are never movers (§6). **Precision-free items:** **Muthoot Finance**, **Aries Agro**, **Infonative Solutions**, **Austin Engineering**, **Bodhtree Consulting** (renaming to Datakosa), **Ironwood Education**, **Indus Finance**, **Landmarc Leisure**, **HMA Agro**, **Vilin Bio Med**, **Paramount Cosmetics**, **Sugs Lloyd**, **KSS** and **Jash Engineering** (investor FAQs) filed general updates and board outcomes with nothing quantified. **Finolex Cables** appointed a company secretary and compliance officer.

**Shareholding and SAST disclosures (names only, per CLAUDE.md §1):** 40 rows today, including Asian Paints, HEG, Chambal Fertilisers, Globus Spirits and Sadhana Nitro Chem. The detail is deliberately not carried.
